_about: Visit counter of our three sites for the owner's stats service (Domlink, owner 2026-11-24, docs/DECISIONS.md). Per site: the same-origin path the page posts to, method, body encoding and field names - the decoding table Domlink needs (format of the catalogs' tracker-map.json). Our Caddy block forwards the body as is to the intake (tools/server-setup.sh). Changing a path or a field here means sending the map to Domlink again before the deploy.
